So many favorites... The first to come to mind: Melancholia, Enter the Void, Interstellar, Mulholland Drive, Inland Empire, Jacob's Ladder, Amores Perros, The Cook the Thief his Wife and Her Lover.

Obvious ones aside (2001 Space Odyssey, Army of Darkness) I'd like to say Speed Racer.

I'm a sucker for visually exciting films, and I thought Speed Racer was just fantastic. I don't think you can get any closer to making a "real life cartoon" then you can with that film.

Subtle things like the way background blurry items become hearts or how the snow during a fist fight turns into those little trailing lines you see in cartoons when people throw punches. The close up shots of peoples heads when they talk, the race tracks, the way the cars fight on the track, etc... great film. Good family fun with lots of fantastic visual work.

I also really liked the cartoon, so I may be a bit bias. :)
